newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,099 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,099 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 2,099 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 45 wheat, 1,030 corn, 870 soybean, 143 soymeal, 10 soyoil and one oats futures contracts traded along with 10 wheat put, 3 corn call and 4 corn put options.

The overnight trend for corn was 3/4 to 1-1/2 cents per bushel higher, soybeans 2-1/4 to 4 cents higher, wheat 3/4 cent higher, soymeal $1.20 per ton higher, soyoil 0.06 cent per lb higher and oats steady to down 1/4 cent per bushel.
